testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate relationships from an origin plane: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:516:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate relationships from an origin plane ✔ Given a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane and an extrusion using that sketch ✔ When the user chooses Relationships from the XY plane row context menu ✔ Then the dialog identifies the XY plane as the selected item ✔ And the Parents list is empty ✔ And the Children list contains the sketch and the extrusion ✔ When the user activates the navigation control beside the sketch ✔ Then the sketch becomes the selected item in the dialog ✔ And the Parents list contains the XY plane and center point ✔ And the Children list contains the extrusion ✔ When the user activates the navigation control beside the XY plane ✔ Then the XY plane becomes the selected item again ✔ And the Parents list is empty ✔ And the Children list contains the sketch and the extrusion ✔ When the user clicks Done ✔ Then the Relationships dialog closes
